decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a low-cost accessory that supports the firm's track lighting systems, so it likely meets its modest aspiration and needs few resources, which leaves no shortfall to trigger search for other uses.

LED luminaires turn over fast and this single model was only mentioned in 2018, but it fits the core business, and without evidence of a shortfall the firm would likely keep it until a successor replaces it.

A home automation server box lies outside the lighting core and faces strong platform competitors, so it likely falls short of aspirations, and problemistic search would move its resources back to luminaires.
The luminaire family had its own dedicated page, which shows strategic weight within the core business, so it likely meets aspirations and is worth keeping.
